page_reference: The official accommodations page labels this image 'Shreve Exterior' and separately describes Shreve Hall as built in 1970.
observations: The photograph confirms the residence hall is a red-brick tower joined to a lower multi-story wing.
The visible tower has repeated narrow vertical window bays, contrasting pale vertical facade strips, and a flat rooftop mechanical enclosure.
A recessed glass entrance sits under a broad projecting canopy with a tall column-supported facade; stairs and a raised approach connect to grade.
The visible photo supports the existing material vocabulary, glazing, entrance canopy, and a rooftop screen, but it does not show the whole building or document scaled elevations.
limitations: The image is only 640x360, is not scaled or georeferenced, and gives no measured building dimensions or exact entrance position.
The photograph date is not supplied by the page.
